text:
maria: Quick ping — PR 42890 updates routing policy, fallback routing in runtime, and a small auth header change. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we can merge. Target merge window Wed 09:00 PST (canary afterwards). Who can take reviews? @sanjay @aisha @jess :pray:

kevin: I can do a quick runtime pass this morning. which files are the risky bits?

maria: Mostly pkg/routing/*, runtime/orch/fallback.go and a small auth change in pkg/net/auth.go. CI shows one flaky test failing intermittently.

kevin: ok. if fallback.go touches the eviction path i'd like to run the perf smoke locally. ping me when CI is green and i'll run it.

sanjay: @maria cc infra — we should confirm rollout plan if this changes cross-tenant routing. I can take infra review but need the canary owner + a short rollback plan.

maria: Rollback plan is simple: flip feature flag runtime.routing_v2=false and revert the canary route. I'll add steps to PR description. Can we get a canary owner for the Wed window?

aisha: I can be canary owner for Wed window, happy to monitor metrics. Need security sign-off on the auth header tweak before I can own the rollout.

jess: Happy to review the auth change tomorrow morning. Quick checklist i'll run through: threat model for header change, header ordering implications, and any new headers logged. If you can add a short note in PR about why the header reorder is needed that helps.

ci-bot: CI: unit (linux): 39/42 passed, 3 flaky failures — rerun queued by @maria. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/42890

merge-bot: Merge window note: Wed 09:00 PST slot available but PR 43111 has a conflicting merge. If both are green, we'll need an order decision to avoid flakes.

maria: Thanks — i've updated PR body with rollback steps and added a test command to reproduce the flaky case:

```bash
./scripts/run-integration.sh --filter TestRoutingFallback
./scripts/ci-smoke.sh --shard=3
```

kevin: thanks. i'll grab runtime review after CI passes and run local perf smoke. small nit: consider making the eviction check idempotent (one-line change). i'll post patch to the PR.

sanjay: for infra: please add the canary tag and expected traffic percentage in the PR description (e.g., 1% -> 10% over 30m). Also add the observability dashboard link for quick checks.

aisha: added canary plan to PR: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m steps, will watch latency, 5xx, and token-service errors.

jess: i'll start the security pass at 08:00 PST tomorrow, should be able to sign off by 11:00 PST. If anything blocks me i'll comment inline.

maria: awesome — summary: @kevin runtime pass after CI green, @sanjay infra review and canary guidance, @jess security sign-off by 11:00, @aisha canary owner. Target merge Wed 09:00 PST assuming green CI + approvals. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can meet that.

kevin: :thumbsup:

sanjay: :thumbsup:

aisha: :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — i'll trigger CI rerun once more and remove the flaky test from the affected shard if it keeps failing. I'll also assign the canary schedule in calendar. If anything changes i'll ping this thread. :rocket:
